about_the_game:
ABOUT:

Play as Clara, a passenger aboard The Comet, a malfunctioning space train, who finds herself stuck in an endless time loop. With only 50-minute intervals before a collision with an asteroid, you must outwit unseen forces to stop this catastrophe and save the lives of everyone on board. Hopefully everyone plans on playing nice...

Keyword: "hopefully."

MECHANICS:

  • Traverse - You're not solely bound to your written choices; feel free to roam about the cabin! You've got a whole space train to explore!

  • Interact - Moving next to doors, people, and even objects may allow you to interact with them, where you can get information, pick up items, travel through train cars, and maybe even be prompted to use a specific item to progress the story forward!

  • Puzzle Solve - Throughout your narrative journey, you may encounter some obstacles that will challenge you to use the information and items you have collected in your inventory to figure out a security passcode or solve a puzzle!

content_descriptors.notes: 50 Minutes Til Impact has many high stakes of life-and-death. Although there may be some violent acts, we do not go into detail nor attempt to make your narrative experience unpleasant to the eyes or mind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13620H (2.40 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX560 or GTX 960
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13620H (2.40 GHz)
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX560 or GTX 960
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

publishers: John Paul the Great Catholic University
short_description: 50 Minutes 'Til Impact is set in a retro-futuristic world aboard an advanced, yet luxurious space train! It's a linear narrative adventure where players utilize 3D exploration, code solving, and visual novel interactions to do whatever they can to save everyone on board before time runs out.
